title: sdr daily scratchpad - outreach plan
content:
Morning runbook:
- Quick review: 9:00 standup with SDR team (Jordan), 10:30 product sync (Caleb)
- Daily goals: 30 dials, 40 emails, 8 LinkedIn touches, 3 qualified conversations
- Primary focus: expand coverage in fintech mid-market (US-East) and follow up on last week's demo pipeline

Priority call list (order of reach):
1) Acme Payments - CTO (Rajiv Singh) - demo last Thurs, open question on data residency. NEEDS: private deployment info + SLA. 'Try to schedule follow-up with Solutions Eng this week'. Next steps: send private deploy one-pager + propose Wed 3/11 11am PT.
2) NovaBank - Head of Infrastructure (Marta Alvarez) - budget review delayed. Action: send tailored case study (banking) + quick ROI calc.
3) Cartflow - VP Product (Liam O.) - cold inbound, interested in latency/cost. Pitch: Dedicated + Optimize features. Book intro call.
4) Streamline Health - Security lead (Derek H.) - compliance questions, ask about KMS/HSM requirements and provide SOC2 summary.
5) OmniScale - Head of ML (Priya K) - wants perf benchmarks on 8k token context. Share perf matrix and invite to benchmark session.

Hot follow-ups (within 48h):
- Acme Payments: email thread with Rajiv, include private-deploy datasheet, cc Solutions Eng (caleb@redwood).
- NovaBank: left voicemail 3/3, send calendar invite for budget alignment call + include preliminary TCO slide.
- Redwood Prod Team trial (internal): remind them to upload sample prompt set for Optimize evaluation.

Scripts / Notes for calls:
- Intro: quick 30s value prop: 'Redwood Inference helps teams run LLM inference with predictable latency and unit cost across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.'
- Objection handling:
  - 'We can self-host': acknowledge, then highlight packaging, rollout tooling, SLAs, and time-to-market savings.
  - 'Cost': offer Optimize recommendation, batching and quantization options, share example TCO from similar customer.
  - 'Security/Compliance': reference Private deployment + KMS/HSM + SOC2.

Admin todos:
- Update CRM with Acme follow-up notes and attach private-deploy one-pager.
- Create JIRA-5421 follow-up for Solutions Eng to prepare demo env for Acme (assign Caleb).
- Log 30 min for benchmark session prep (today afternoon).

Metrics / tracker:
- This week: meetings booked = 3/8 target, conversions to demo = 2, SQLs = 1.
- Pipeline notes: Acme (high), NovaBank (mid), Cartflow (mid), OmniScale (low)

Quick reminders / personal notes:
- Bring demo laptop charger to product sync.
- Follow up with Jordan on script tweaks for cold calls (use shorter opener).
- Check recording from last week's sales roundup for tips on objection handling.

End of day checklist:
- Log activities in CRM, update lead statuses, send follow-up emails for all warm leads, prep materials for tomorrow's demos.

Raw call notes (scratch):
- Acme: asked about encryption at rest, surprised by private on-prem option. Rajiv asked about migration timeline -> said ~6-8 weeks for pilot.
- NovaBank: skeptical re: switching vendors, wants references from fintech. Mentioned BridgeBank case study.
- Cartflow: curious about streaming tokens and partial response streaming latency. Suggested try hosted API first.

TODO (short):
- Send Acme one-pager (ASAP)
- Draft NovaBank ROI slide (by EOD)
- Book Cartflow intro call (today)
- Share SOC2 link with Streamline Health

Notes to self: keep outreach conversational, prioritize follow-ups that unblock demos, and always loop in Solutions Eng early when infra/security is in play.
content_summary: SDR daily scratchpad with prioritized call list, follow-ups, scripts, admin todos, metrics and raw call notes.
